---
title: "Results"
---

## Scale

The complete archive has been processed. Every propagation card in the collection,
spanning roughly fifty years of nursery records, has been read by the pipeline.

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Source PDFs processed | 513 |
| Total cards extracted | 12,762 |
| Successfully processed | 12,557 |
| Failed or errored | 153 |
| Excluded (unpaired duplex pages) | 52 |
| **Success rate** | **98.8%** |
| Fields captured per card | 22 |
| Hardware | Apple Silicon Mac (M4, 24 GB), no internet |
| Model | `qwen2.5vl:7b` via Ollama |
| Render resolution | 175 DPI |
| Avg processing time per card | 55.8 seconds |
| Total processing time | 194.5 hours |

The 153 failures were primarily empty model responses (117 JSON parse errors)
and intermittent Ollama server errors (29). These are retryable, not
architectural.

## Card types

| Type | Count | % |
|---|---|---|
| Single-face cards | 10,586 | 83% |
| Duplex (front and back) | 2,176 | 17% |

The 52 excluded cards come from duplex PDFs with odd page counts where
front/back pairing was not possible.

## Accession numbers

The pipeline extracted 14,571 accession number entries across all cards,
resolving to 13,277 unique normalized accessions. Some cards reference multiple
accessions (multi-sowing tables). The 14% of cards without an accession number
are primarily pre-2012 failed sowings that were never assigned one.

| Format | Count | % |
|---|---|---|
| Legacy (pre-IrisBG) | 9,856 | 68% |
| Unknown/partial | 2,791 | 19% |
| Modern (post-IrisBG) | 1,623 | 11% |
| Modern item-level | 283 | 2% |

## RAG-assisted extraction

92% of cards (11,524) received taxonomy hints from the RAG index during
extraction, averaging 458 tokens of context per card with a retrieval latency
of 14 ms. The RAG step provides the model with accession-to-taxon mappings from
the institution's database, improving accession number and botanical name
accuracy without additional model calls.

## Accuracy

Field-level accuracy scoring against a manually reviewed sample has not yet been
completed. The earlier prototype (OpenCV alignment + Google Cloud Vision with
dynamic template matching) reached roughly **90-98%** accuracy on the fields it
targeted, useful as a reference point, though it required cloud calls, an
internet connection, and far narrower scope.

A formal accuracy assessment is planned: a stratified sample of cards (old vs.
new, seed vs. cutting, single vs. multi-sowing) scored against ground-truth
transcriptions.

## Honest failure modes

Credibility comes from naming what doesn't work:

- **Condensed multi-sowing tables**: the hardest case. Several accessions on
  one card in a hand-drawn table format. Easy to merge or drop rows. These
  represent approximately 17% of cards with unknown extraction outcomes.
- **Faded carbon copies**: low-contrast old cards (pre-1980s triplicates)
  degrade transcription quality.
- **Ambiguous handwriting on accession digits**: a single misread digit
  produces a plausible-but-wrong accession. The RAG validation step catches
  many of these, but not all.
- **No-accession cards**: pre-2012 failed sowings rely on taxon-name matching,
  which inherits any error in the taxon transcription.
- **Family name case inconsistency**: the model transcribes family names as
  written on the card, producing duplicates like "Ericaceae" and "ERICACEAE."
  Normalizable in post-processing, but present in the raw output.
